SubLevelDesc: Give 2 subtrahends without borrow. Litre is a single digit number and ml is a 3 digit number.
Expression:
$majorunit = 'l'
$minorunit = 'ml'
$mulFactor = 1000
$opnmjr1 = random(5, 9)
$opnmjr2 = random(1, 4)
$opnmnr1 = random([555, 666, 777, 888, 999, 565, 567, 568, 569, 665, 667, 668, 669, 775, 776, 778, 779, 885, 886, 887, 889, 995, 996, 997, 998])
$opnmnr2 = random([111, 112, 113, 114, 222, 223, 224, 221, 331, 332, 333, 334, 441, 442, 443, 444])
$nums = [toNumber($mulFactor), toNumber($opnmjr1), toNumber($opnmjr2), toNumber($opnmnr1), toNumber($opnmnr2)]
$borrow = iff((($opnmnr1 - $opnmnr2))<0, $mulFactor, 0)
$ansmnr = (($opnmnr1 + $borrow) - $opnmnr2) % $mulFactor
$ansmjr = ($opnmjr1 - $borrow/$mulFactor) - $opnmjr2
Description: Tests the concept of subtraction of capacity.
Subject: Other
